messages.content: 想像一下你是一個無人機操作員。你目前正在操作一架位於天空中的無人機，座標為（5，7）。你被要求將無人機移動到一個新的座標（10，15）。到達新座標後，你又被要求將無人機移動到另一個座標（20，25）。你能用歐幾里得範數法計算出無人機總共飛行的距離嗎？

function.name: math_hypot
function.description: Calculate the Euclidean norm, sqrt(sum(squares)), the length of the vector from the origin to point (x, y) which is the hypotenuse of the right triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

z.description: Optional. The z-coordinate value. Default is 0.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to imagine being a drone operator, currently at coordinates (5,7). They need to move to (10,15), then to (20,25). They want to calculate total flight distance using Euclidean norm. So we need to compute distance between (5,7) and (10,15), then between (10,15) and (20,25). Sum them. Use Euclidean distance formula sqrt((dx)^2 + (dy)^2). We can use the provided function math_hypot. But the function signature expects x, y, optional z. For 2D, we can pass x difference and y difference. So we can call math_hypot with x=dx, y=dy. Then sum.

Compute dx1 = 10-5 = 5, dy1 = 15-7 = 8. Distance1 = sqrt(5^2 + 8^2) = sqrt(25+64)=sqrt(89) ≈ 9.433... Next dx2 = 20-10 = 10, dy2 = 25-15 = 10. Distance2 = sqrt(10^2+10^2)=sqrt(200)=14.142... Sum ≈ 23.575... Provide exact sqrt values or approximate. Provide explanation. Use function calls. We'll call math_hypot twice.
